reference: 월계수/빨간 가로리본 메달에서 실물감을 제거하고 크기를 줄이라는 사용자 요청 (2026-10-14)
style: 간결한 2D 그림·둥근 윤곽선·밝은 색상·큰 숫자·짧은 빨간 리본

prompts.gold: REDRAW the attached medal as a SMALL, totally FLAT 2D cartoon/vector illustration for an app icon. Preserve only the concept: scalloped circular badge, numeral "1", two simple laurel sprigs, a short RED horizontal ribbon across the lower front. Do not preserve any realistic rendering. Use large simple shapes, smooth rounded outlines, a friendly stationery/sticker drawing style. ZERO gradients, ZERO texture, ZERO reflections, ZERO lighting, ZERO bevels, ZERO shadows, ZERO metallic highlights, ZERO 3D volume: each filled region must be one uniform solid color like an SVG icon. Limited palette: disk #F4C95D, dark rounded outline and bold numeral #876428, cream simple laurel leaves #FFF7E2, ribbon flat muted red #DF6C67 with dark red outline #9D4850. Five oval leaves on each laurel sprig only. Thin outline about 3% of badge width, fewer than 12 round lobes on outside. Bold simple numeral must stay legible at 38px display width. Ribbon has two short folded pointed ends and a blank front, no thin gold decorative lines. Compact symmetrical centered composition: disk 72% width, ribbon 88% width, whole illustration about 82% height with small transparent margins. Genuine transparent alpha background, no checkerboard pattern. No text other than "1", no watermark or logos. The output must look like a hand-drawn flat web sticker, NOT a medal photograph and NOT a rendered metal object.
